mintAuthority.summary: USDso inherits frxUSD issuer risk and has twenty-one reviewed local native deployments. Chain-specific Safes control token and factory upgrades, custodian beacons and token role administration. Ethereum uses three of five owners; Somnia and the other reviewed chains use three of six. Each Safe can authorize deposit-free local token minting outside the collateral-taking custodian path. Local balances reconcile at their own pins, but complete global and in-flight liability reconciliation remains unestablished.
